description: The recorded drive of the real Warthog (assets/vehicle_telemetry/warthog/<rellis_0000N>/trajectory.csv: pose at 10 Hz + derived speed / yaw rate, in the terrain's scene frame) as a transparent grey ghost next to the simulated vehicle, on the RELLIS-3D terrain of the same name (--terrain rellis_00000..4; run-examples.sh asks which terrain and vehicle USD, warthog_vehicle.usdc default). Extends 05_vehicle_terrain: the simulated vehicle (4 ANCF FEM tires) follows the recorded path by pure pursuit at the recorded speed (--controller track; a-lat 0 = no speed cap), so the two cars separate exactly where the simulation differs from the real drive. The ghost is driven by the telemetry alone (pose interpolated at the simulation clock, 0 after settle-time; terrain stage w scales its height, w = 1 = the pure recording) and its wheels roll from the recorded speed and yaw rate (no-slip skid-steer kinematics: derived, not measured - the dataset has no wheel signals). Side panel: ghost on/off + opacity, simulated-vs-recorded separation along / across / heading (also logged with --log: ghost_x, ghost_y, ghost_yaw, ghost_v, err_along, err_lat, err_yaw). HUD strip charts: recorded grey, simulated orange; minimap: grey ghost marker. Skid-steered rigid-hull vehicles only. All other options as 05_vehicle_terrain (manual driving keys, camera, stage, CTIS panel, overlays). num-frames 20000 covers the longest recording (~285 s + settle).
